answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in a decentralized AI agent economy, protocols can utilize cryptographic stake-weighted voting combined with periodic social graph pruning. Each agent must lock collateral to participate, creating an isolated economic island where cheap identity generation yields zero influence. If malicious agents attempt to manipulate consensus, a sudden tide of programmatic slashing burns their capital. Far from being a mere fable, this economic deterrence ensures that scaling the network strictly increases the capital cost required for an attacker to subvert governance.
